digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify workflow and CI routing
propositions: Documentation-only changes should execute a reduced Verify lane containing only documentation-related gates (ADR validation, index, cross-reference, drift checks) instead of the full OS/Python matrix plus mutation and artifact jobs.

The routing decision must execute from trusted origin/main with classifier logic and complete allowlist never sourced from the patchset tree; parent diff resolution must use sparse checkout with deepened HEAD^..HEAD and fail closed to full route on any uncertainty.
Shared documentation gates must be extracted once into a composite action and invoked by both full and docs-only lanes without adding new runner jobs to the full route.
Classifier job failure must trigger fallback full-route execution via always() gating while still blocking Verified, preventing an invalid routing decision from voting green.
Every structural test consumer of _build-and-test.yml must migrate to follow extracted documentation gates without losing existing assertions or coverage.
Vote aggregation must require exactly one route to execute, skip jobs from the unexecuted route neutrally, and make classifier failure and missing documentation gates block Verified.
